crosscutting.title: Menu, toolbar, hotspots and keyboard
crosscutting.finding: Original menu hierarchy is freshly recovered from serialized records and metadata bindings. Toolbar/office events are inventoried, but numeric event slots do not by themselves identify Click/KeyDown meanings.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Trace each bound event, array-index switch and keyboard branch; pair all 55 menu dispositions with a current route or explicit absent/dormant state.

crosscutting.title: Screens, layouts, buttons and window lifetime
crosscutting.finding: All 84 forms have known layout-region anchors. Known non-menu instances and picture-property hashes are bound to owners; two root and 228 instance property streams are partial.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Resolve stopped property streams; distinguish dynamic controls/default properties; verify dimensions, fonts, tooltip/focus, dialog owner/modality and drag/reopen/selection position on Windows.

crosscutting.title: Timelines, automatic triggers and ordering
crosscutting.finding: Module1/Module2 and all known serialized timers are inventoried. Direct P-code thunks and object-reference sites are indexed; dynamic calls and state aliases are not a complete scheduler graph.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Label callback slots, resolve timer enable/interval writers and caller continuation; observe actor/weekly/monthly/yearly order, stalls, simultaneous events and window drag.

crosscutting.title: Globals, members, arrays and native RNG
crosscutting.finding: Operand reference sites are mechanically indexed. Pool addresses retain unclassified roles; member offsets retain unknown receiver identity. Existing local RNG evidence does not establish whole-session draw ordering.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Classify pool cells and receiver-qualified members; map readers/writers, aliases and seeds/draw ordering using startup and saved checkpoints.

crosscutting.title: Persistence and migration
crosscutting.finding: Native save/load spans 009D9824/009D60E0 are fingerprinted and 669 procedures are indexed. Modern numbered JSON slots and migrations are implemented; native GD2 interoperability remains unsupported.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Complete ordered native field/type/array map and transient/nonpersistent cells; obtain genuine GD2 fixtures and cross-load/save comparisons before claiming compatibility.

crosscutting.title: Artwork, icons, patches and external files
crosscutting.finding: Known property payloads bind 400 BMP, 22 GIF, 113 ICO and one CUR occurrence. Repetition counts are not distinct artwork counts. Source-handler use and dynamic picture assignment remain partial; no fresh LZH denominator exists.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Supply original archive; inventory every entry/hash/type; map all picture writers and use-sites, sprite subdivisions/masks, English patch regions and per-window icon/button identity.

crosscutting.title: Original audio and music
crosscutting.finding: The evidence manifest identifies four asynchronous single-voice effect selectors and known call sites; selector 3 has no call in the known dispatcher references. Community/meeting/seasonal music paths are a separate comparison.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Inventory archive audio and every direct/indirect playback site; establish selector/context, interruption/overlap/mute/loop/stop and resume on the original. Do not create a trigger for an unused selector.

crosscutting.title: Tables, formulas and importer coverage
crosscutting.finding: Existing importers recover catalog families from the initialization procedure at 009F651C; metadata/procedure/reference inventory starts from the original, not the current catalog model. Raw members retain unknown semantics.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Reconcile every initialization assignment/table/helper with a schema or explicit unknown; compare source row counts/types with importers and model fields. Existing imported rows are not a denominator for all original tables.

crosscutting.title: Archive and original runtime acceptance
crosscutting.finding: Original PE is available and freshly hash-verified. A private Wine 11 binary exists, but no complete original distribution or established runnable game installation is available. Native Windows acceptance and all 245 paired workflow scenarios remain pending.
crosscutting.next_evidence: Use a disposable Windows install with the matching original distribution. Record original archive/runtime versions and execute catalog scenarios with captures/state checkpoints, then compare the adaptation.

gaps.task: Obtain original archive and runtime evidence; complete external-file denominator and pair 245 scenario recordings. This blocks a claim of complete game coverage.
Recover the four-form poaching transaction and its periodic/menu callbacks; adaptation workflow is missing.
Resolve all original menu/toolbar/hotspot/keyboard routes, including backup purchase, poaching, casino submenu and information/settings options; distinguish missing, dormant and replaced routes.
Classify dynamic dispatch targets, timer interval/enable writers, scheduler order and actor/callback persistence; direct-call graph alone is incomplete.
Complete native GD2 field/type/array mapping and whole-session RNG seed/draw-order comparisons as separate compatibility projects.

Implement the source-backed backup-device purchase/ownership and corresponding virus protection only after tracing event mutations/persistence; this is absent from the adaptation and distinct from JSON backup files.
Decode two stopped root and 228 stopped control-property streams; determine whether unsupported classes/streams contain additional controls or resources.
Reconcile every original artwork/audio/table use, including archive-only race sheets and dynamic assignments. 536 known picture properties do not prove complete resource coverage.
Reconcile NativeWindowArtwork graduate/renewal aliases with the source forms; icon association does not establish workflow identity.
Resolve utility forms and fGMZishaNet data initialization/writers before exposing guessed behavior.
Verify all presented screens, selections, button glyphs, graph blocks, bilingual patches, window retention, focus and drag-time suspension on the original Windows runtime.
